Title: Insufficient night-time helmet dataset coverage
Description: Current validation set contains limited low-light, rain, glare, and motion-blur samples, reducing confidence in production performance.
Impact: Model may miss helmet violations in adverse conditions.
Action: Add low-light, rain, glare, occlusion, and motion-blur samples and rerun validation.
Acceptance_Criteria: Validation set covers all agreed adverse scenarios and performance is reported per scenario.
Evidence_Required: Updated dataset manifest and evaluation report

Title: OCR accuracy below acceptance threshold
Description: Number-plate OCR produces inconsistent text under blur, skew, small plate size, and poor illumination.
Impact: Incorrect plate text can cause unreliable evidence records.
Action: Tune preprocessing, confidence thresholds, plate cropping, and OCR fallback handling.
Acceptance_Criteria: OCR meets the approved accuracy threshold on the held-out validation set.
Evidence_Required: OCR benchmark with confidence distribution and error samples

Title: Backend inference API contract not finalized
Description: Frontend and backend teams have not finalized request/response fields for image inference, confidence values, and evidence identifiers.
Impact: Integration testing and UI binding are blocked.
Action: Publish versioned API schema and example payloads; obtain frontend sign-off.
Acceptance_Criteria: API contract is documented, versioned, tested, and approved by frontend and backend leads.
Evidence_Required: API specification and integration test results

Title: Define helmet/person/vehicle association rules
Description: The system needs deterministic rules for associating a detected person with a helmet and vehicle before creating a violation record.
Impact: Incorrect association can create false violations.
Action: Document spatial, temporal, confidence, and tracking rules and validate against representative scenes.
Acceptance_Criteria: Rules are documented and verified against at least 20 representative scenarios.

Title: Evidence retention policy pending approval
Description: Retention duration and access rules for original images, cropped plates, OCR text, and derived violation records are not yet approved.
Impact: Production deployment cannot pass governance review.
Action: Finalize retention, deletion, access-control, and audit requirements.
Acceptance_Criteria: Security and product owners approve the evidence retention policy.

Title: Duplicate evidence records generated on retry
Description: Repeated API requests can create duplicate violation records when the client retries after a timeout.
Impact: Duplicate records reduce data integrity and may inflate violation counts.
Action: Implement idempotency keys and database uniqueness constraints.
Acceptance_Criteria: Repeated requests with the same idempotency key create only one evidence record.

Title: Create end-to-end representative test pack
Description: Prepare a controlled test pack covering compliant riders, non-compliant riders, multiple riders, partial occlusion, night scenes, and unreadable plates.
Impact: Release confidence cannot be established without repeatable end-to-end tests.
Action: Create labeled test scenarios and expected outcomes.
Acceptance_Criteria: All critical scenarios have expected outcomes and traceable test IDs.
Evidence_Required: E2E test matrix and execution report

Title: Inference latency may exceed operational target
Description: YOLO detection plus OCR and evidence persistence may exceed the target processing time on constrained hardware.
Impact: Slow processing may reduce throughput for traffic-camera workloads.
Action: Benchmark model variants, image resolution, batching, and OCR execution strategy.
Acceptance_Criteria: Measured p50/p95 latency is within the approved operational target.

Title: Add negative and security tests for uploads
Description: Upload handling must reject unsupported files, malformed content, oversized files, and potentially unsafe inputs.
Impact: Unvalidated inputs may create availability or security issues.
Action: Add negative, boundary, authorization, and malformed-file tests.
Acceptance_Criteria: All defined upload abuse cases are rejected safely and logged.

Title: Human review required for uncertain violations
Description: Low-confidence helmet status or OCR results must be routed for manual review instead of being treated as confirmed violations.
Impact: Reduces risk of automated false-positive enforcement decisions.
Action: Define review thresholds and UI states for uncertain results.
Acceptance_Criteria: Uncertain results are clearly marked and routed to a review workflow.
Evidence_Required: Approved decision policy and UI test evidence
